blocks.text: Draft for Jared's approval. Built only from the monthly MLS® figures (SnapStats) for condos and townhomes in Maillardville. No local notes, sold prices, building list or live listing feed yet; see the open items.

Maillardville, Coquitlam: 41 condos and townhomes listed at the end of September 2026 and 5 sold in the month, a sales ratio of 12%, which the reports’ scale reads as a balanced market. By listings that is number 5 of 23 Coquitlam communities for condos and townhomes.

blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal. The reports count condos and townhomes together in one line, so this table cannot separate the two. Shares are this community’s count divided by the Coquitlam total for condos and townhomes that month.

blocks.text: Listings of condos and townhomes in Maillardville fell from 46 in June to 41 in September, and 13 sold across the 4 months. In September the community held 5.1% of Coquitlam’s 806 condos and townhomes listed.
Condos and townhomes or houses in Maillardville?
Maillardville also had 14 houses listed and 0 sold in September, against 41 condos and townhomes listed. The Maillardville houses page has those figures.

faq.q: How many condos and townhomes are for sale in Maillardville?
faq.a: At the end of September 2026 the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® figures showed 41 condos and townhomes listed in Maillardville. That is a month-end count and it moves daily; ask Jared what is on the market today.

faq.q: Is Maillardville a buyers’ or sellers’ market for condos and townhomes?
faq.a: In September 2026, condos and townhomes in Maillardville had a sales ratio of 12%, which the reports’ scale reads as a balanced market. On the reports’ scale under 12% favours buyers, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% favours sellers.

faq.q: How many condos and townhomes sold in Maillardville from June to September 2026?
faq.a: 13 condos and townhomes sold in Maillardville over those 4 months, out of 475 in all of Coquitlam.

faq.q: Do these numbers separate condos from townhomes?
faq.a: No. The monthly reports publish condos and townhomes as one line, so every count here includes both. Jared can pull the split for a specific building or street.
